privacy.label: PRIVACY
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: CPWD.nl is an informational website. We do not keep visitor profiles and we have no user accounts. This policy explains what minimal processing does take place.
privacy.rightsIntro: Even with minimal processing you have rights under the GDPR. Questions? Email info{'@'}cpwd.nl.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy? Email info{'@'}cpwd.nl. CPWD is based in the Netherlands.
privacy.authorityBody: If you disagree with how we handle your request, you may lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl).

sections.title: No storage
paragraphs: This website is informational. We do not maintain a database of visitor profiles, accounts or newsletters.
Visits to cpwd.nl are not linked to a personal dossier. We do keep anonymous totals: which pages are viewed, on which day, and from which country. No IP address, no name and no message content.

sections.title: Contact form
paragraphs: If you use our contact form, we send your message directly by email. That data is not stored in a database on this website.
We only keep email correspondence as long as needed to handle your enquiry.

sections.title: Technical logs
paragraphs: Our hosting provider may keep standard server logs (such as IP address and browser type) for security and stability. We do not have direct access to a visitor registry.
These logs fall under our processor agreement with our host and are retained briefly.

sections.title: Visitor scan in the homepage animation
paragraphs: The homepage may show a one-time playful scan inside its existing animation. It displays your public IP address and a broad, approximate network location when our hosting provider includes that information.

For a best-effort VPN, proxy or Tor indication and network provider name, our server sends the public IP address to ipapi.is. The result may be incomplete or inaccurate. When a VPN is detected, the displayed city is the VPN exit location, not your residence.
CPWD does not store these details or the lookup result in a database.

sections.title: Anonymous totals
paragraphs: For an internal statistics page we count page views, contact requests, planner requests and scans. By day, by page and by country.
Those totals contain no IP address, no name, no email and no message content. The page is not public and is not in the navigation.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We only use functional cookies and local browser storage, for example for language preference and to skip the original loading animation after a first visit.
No tracking or advertising cookies. You can manage cookies in your browser.
The private statistics page sets one functional session cookie after a successful login. A normal visit does not set it.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: This privacy policy may be updated. The current version is always published on this page.
For material changes we update the date at the top.
